messages:
alisha: Heads-up from support: customers noticed an increase in failures after yesterday's prune job. We started emitting a tombstone signal when a model variant is removed. Need quick call on canonical API semantics + console treatment. 410? 404? custom header?

ben: Don't return 503. It causes client SDKs to spin retries and hides the real cause. 410 seems closest to spec.

maria: 410 (Gone) is fine, but we should provide structured metadata so console + telemetry can differentiate planned prunes vs accidental deletions.

jason: Proposal: HTTP 410 with header `X-RW-Error: TOMBSTONED` and `X-RW-Tombstone-Reason: scheduled|manual|orphaned`. Also include `X-RW-Fallback-Allowed: true|false`.

alisha: Sample response idea (for SDKs):
```
HTTP/1.1 410 Gone
Content-Type: application/json
X-RW-Error: TOMBSTONED
X-RW-Tombstone-Reason: scheduled
X-RW-Fallback-Allowed: false

{
  "error": {
    "code": "MODEL_TOMBSTONED",
    "message": "variant m-8b-v1 removed (scheduled prune)",
    "retryable": false,
    "meta": { "reason": "scheduled", "fallback_allowed": false }
  }
}
```

ben: Exactly. SDKs should expose a typed exception (ModelTombstonedError) with fields reason, fallback_allowed, and suggested_action. Avoid forcing apps to parse headers.

maria: Telemetry: add event tag `tombstone.reason` (enum: scheduled, manual, orphaned, unknown), `tombstone.route_type` (pinned, flexible), `tombstone.fallback_effect` (fell_back, failed), and `tombstone.count`. Dashboards should show trend and heatmap by route.

jason: Console UX: on a route row, show a small orange pill "variant removed" with tooltip explaining reason and recommended next step (pin to new variant, update split, open rollout). Also add a one-click filter to surface all tombstoned variants in last 7 days.

alisha: Edge-case: if route is pinned we should fail fast rather than silently fallback. Add `tombstone.pinned=true` to the error meta and telemetry.

ben: Regarding retry semantics: never let tombstone alone imply immediate retry. Only allow Retry-After if we have a scheduled replacement ETA. Otherwise set retryable=false.

maria: For the runtime fallback policy: default for non-pinned routes -> try next compatible variant when `fallback_allowed=true`. Emit telemetry `tombstone.fallback_attempted=true/false` and `tombstone.post_fallback_status=ok|degraded|error` so we can measure quality impact.

devops-bot: prune-job 2026-03-20T23:31:02Z completed in us-west-2. tombstones=38.

jason: Question for product: should we surface tombstone as "degraded" or "removed" in the route health UI? I vote "removed" (more accurate).

alisha: Agreed. Removed + actionable CTA. Also provide a CSV export for ops with columns: route_id, variant_id, reason, fallback_allowed, pinned, timestamp.

ben: I'll draft the runtime PR that emits headers + structured JSON errors and telemetry tags.

maria: I'll update metrics schema and add a Grafana panel mock.

jason: I'll implement SDK typed error and add migration notes to changelog.

alisha: Product will draft the console microcopy (hover text + CTA flows) and link to docs.

ben: Action items summarized: runtime headers & 410 semantics, SDK typed error, telemetry schema additions, console badging + export, product microcopy.

alisha: Thanks team. Let's re-check in two days after initial PRs land. :rocket:
